bias.en: Bearish · two-day drop broke every support, SAR bearish
bias.zh: 偏空 · 两日急跌跌破全部支撑，SAR 转空

read.en: Marvell fell 10.0% on Oct 30 to $196.40 (range $190.15–207.61) on twice average volume, after a 13.2% drop on Oct 29. It is below the falling 5-day ($228.75), 10-day ($231.80), 30-day ($252.70) and 100-day ($238.39), and above the rising 200-day ($183.19). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR turned bearish on Oct 29 ($253.66), and RSI is 34.
read.zh: Marvell 10月30日下跌 10.0%，收于 $196.40（区间 $190.15–207.61），成交量为均量的 2 倍；此前 10月29日已下跌 13.2%。股价低于下行的 5 日（$228.75）、10 日（$231.80）、30 日（$252.70）和 100 日均线（$238.39），高于上行的 200 日均线（$183.19）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 于 10月29日转为看空（$253.66），RSI 为 34。

read.en: The two-day drop broke all three written supports, $246–250, $236–240 and $220.2, and flipped the SAR bearish. Resistance is $200.6–207.6 (Sep 1 low, Oct 30 high), then $220.2–225.7 (Oct 22 low, Oct 29 high) and $228.8–231.8 (5 and 10-day). Support is $188.3–190.2 (Oct 30 low, Jul 16–17 closes), then $183.2 (200-day) and $178 (Jul 17 low). A close above $207.6 would target $220–226; below $188, $183.
